welcome to The Jungle Village
We are the first Jungle Lodge in Puerto Iguazú, pioneers in providing an experience that combines comfort and nature. We are distinguished by the attention to detail, the closeness to the guests and the genuine harmony of our spaces with the environment.
Discover our hotel
We invite you to visit our facilities and surroundings.
See Gallery

El hotel es espectacular, muy limpio, prolijo, el personal es muy atento y dispuesto a resolver cualquier inconveniente. El desayuno muy bueno, abundante y variado. Ñande Roga
A 90m² replica of a typical missionary house, Ñande Roga means "big house" in the Guaraní language. It is ideal for families, as it can accommodate up to six people and offers the possibility of enjoying much of the comfort of home during your stay. It features a living room and a dining room decorated with furniture featuring local details, and three bedrooms.
